purpose: Spot-check class-specific inline-XBRL contexts in original SEC filings; no prices or returns
retrieval: Read original SEC HTML through the document fetcher on 2026-11-11; matched the share facts to their contextRef and inspected the referenced xbrli:context. The 2024 response was truncated after the relevant contexts and facts; no full-file hash is claimed.

issuer_report_capture.check: The 14:53:37 UTC capture and a separately retrieved 15:19:14 UTC capture have identical SHA-256 hashes. pdftotext of the latter shows both February 12 share counts. The local SHA-1 in base32 agrees with the archive CDX digest.
issuer_report_capture.limitation: The archive timestamp supports an upper bound, conditional on its accuracy; it does not establish first publication or an independently timestamped hash.

limitations: Fact instant is not a public-dissemination timestamp or a guarantee that the count remains current at a later decision.
Ticker facts and share facts have different XBRL period contexts in the 2021 filing despite matching class members; the meaning of each period must be retained.
Two filings do not establish completeness of any historical source or why the SEC company-facts response omitted these observations.
These contexts alone do not establish tradable security identity, contemporaneous prices, source-wide mapping or a stock-selection signal.
